items.title: Iranian-American actress Sepideh Moafi pays tribute to Iranian protesters with Golden Globes dress
items.description:
Iranian-American actress Sepideh Moafi, known for her roles in The L Word: Generation Q and Black Bird, paid tribute to Iranian protesters with her dress at the Golden Globe Awards.
